entities.name: Titus Veturius Geminus Cicurinus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Titus Veturius Geminus Cicurinus was a Roman Republican patrician politician and general of the gens Veturia. He served as a Roman consul in 494 BC together with Aulus Verginius Tricostus Caeliomontanus.
